title: Multi-Task Learning for Features Extraction in Financial Annual Reports
reasoning: The paper focuses on extracting features related to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) criteria from financial reports using multi-task learning with RoBERTa. While ESG relates to corporate social responsibility and ethical business frameworks, the research goal is textual feature extraction and classification performance (e.g., sentiment, objectivity) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning within the language models themselves.
